summary: Slide Ridge (also Slide Peak) L-5 cab built 1935, sold and removed in 1939; location uncertain and no remnants found on the highest point.

facts.status_note: Sold in 1939 and removed per FFLOS and firelookout.com. WillhiteWeb found no remnants on the highest point and says the exact location is uncertain.

access.note: Reached by National Forest roads and a fire trail per WillhiteWeb; no closure or permit found in the sources read

visit.trail_note: Park at the saddle under Slide Peak and walk a fire trail about one mile up the ridge, per WillhiteWeb. High clearance advised for the road.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS and firelookout.com use Slide Ridge; WillhiteWeb cites a 1935 inventory entry for Slide Peak. The same 1935 L-5 cab and 1939 sale appear in every source, so one lookout is assumed.

notes_for_editor: Location is uncertain per WillhiteWeb, which uses the eastern point of Slide Peak for now. The record's coordinates (47.91393, -120.26551) match the FFLOS listing; they may not be that point, so consider marking the pin approximate. Access is set to public because the route is National Forest roads and a fire trail; no closure was found, but this was not confirmed on the ground. No staffing source found.
